name: iblusend
description: Safely triage conversations, inspect contacts and devices, and send confirmed iMessages and SMS through one consented workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Safely triage conversations, inspect contacts and devices, and send confirmed iMessages and SMS through one consented workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect one iBluSend workspace to read conversations, contacts, devices, groups, delivery, opt-out and bot status, and send one confirmed message at a time. Areas the person ticks add reports, templates, campaigns, the calendar and invoices (drafts only; nothing launches or charges), plus contact edits, iMessage extras and calendar booking under Read and act, only for contacts the person approves.
defaultPrompt: Triage my iBluSend inbox and flag conversations that need a reply.
Draft a reply for one contact, then wait for my approval before sending.
Check this contact's opt-out status and show available sending devices.
